title: Christiansted National Historic Site
summary: Christiansted National Historic Site was established in 1952 as the first unit of the National Park Service in the Virgin Islands of the United States. Covering over seven acres the park tells the stories about Danish economy and ways of life, and the interactions of people in Europe, Africa, West Indies, and North America during the Danish era of occupation of the Virgin Islands (1734-1917).

title: Green Cay National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Green Cay National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1977 to protect the endangered St. Croix ground lizard. The refuge consists of the entire 14-acre island of Green Cay. The refuge extends only to sea level and does not include any of the submerged marine habitat, including coral reefs that surround the island.
